title: Database connection timeouts
items: Check the connection pool usage on the service dashboard
Look for long-running queries on the primary database
If the pool is exhausted, restart the affected service instances one by one
If the primary is unresponsive, fail over to the replica
Note in the alert what was done and resolve it once errors stop

title: Restarting a service
content: Drain the instance from the load balancer, wait for in-flight requests to finish, restart it and put it back once its health check passes. Never restart more than one instance of a service at a time.
